title: Roots of unity on the ordinary small etale site
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $N\in\mathbb N$. On its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], the abelian sheaf $\mu_{N,T}$ assigns to $U\to T$ the group $\{z\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)^\times:z^N=1\}$, with multiplication as group law and restriction induced by the ring maps on sections. Equivalently it is the kernel of the $N$-th power map on the sheaf of units.
